text: House numbers in France are most commonly blue, typically written in a serif font with slightly exaggerated shapes. This is most useful when differentiating from Italy, which almost never uses blue house number signs.
NOTE: Similar designs can be found in all other neighbouring, as well as many other, countries.
text_zh: 法國的門牌號碼最常見的是藍色，通常以帶有稍微誇張造型的襯線字體書寫。這在區分義大利時非常有用，因為義大利幾乎從不使用藍色門牌號碼標誌。
注意：類似的設計也可以在所有其他鄰國以及許多其他國家找到。

text: House numbers in Czechia are generally written on **blue** or **red signs** with thin white borders.
NOTE: On the contrary, Slovak house numbers are typically written on [**white signs**](https://goo.gl/maps/arqzJku5JuJJ3CcQ8)** **with a thin red or black border.
text_zh: 捷克的門牌號碼通常寫在帶有細白邊的**藍色**或**紅色標誌**上。
注意：相對地，斯洛伐克的門牌號碼通常寫在帶有細紅邊或黑邊的[**白色標誌**](https://goo.gl/maps/arqzJku5JuJJ3CcQ8)** **上。

text: Pairs of black and white house numbers are found in Brno.
NOTE: The city district can be found written on the black house number.
text_zh: 黑白配對的門牌號碼可在布爾諾找到。
注意：行政區劃名稱會寫在黑色門牌號碼上。

text: Pilsen house numbers typically consist of two red and white octagonal plates with inverse colour schemes.
text_zh: 皮爾森的門牌號碼通常由兩個紅白相間、顏色配置相反的八角形牌子組成。

text: House numbers in České Budějovice have one red and one white plate with **underlined numbers**.
text_zh: 捷克布傑約維采的門牌號碼有一個紅牌和一個白牌，並附有**底線數字**。

text: Red house numbers with a **dividing line** and a **Roman numeral** are unique to Liberec.
The dividing line is an important identifying factor, as Roman numerals can be found on house numbers in [other cities.](https://goo.gl/maps/dS4PNxQdieaMEBxm9)
text_zh: 帶有**分隔線**和**羅馬數字**的紅色門牌號碼是利貝雷茨特有的。
分隔線是一個重要的辨識特徵，因為羅馬數字也可能出現在[其他城市](https://goo.gl/maps/dS4PNxQdieaMEBxm9)的門牌號碼上。

text: Písek uses **yellow house numbers** with a black outline.
text_zh: 皮塞克使用配有黑色外框的**黃色門牌號碼**。

text: It is fairly common to find **oval-shaped** blue house numbers in Estonia.

NOTE: This is not common in the other Baltic countries, but can also be found in [Russia](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.0913517,28.1667574,3a,15y,304.49h,91.94t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTX_XXjOnF4tmR0_rySvAQQ!2e0!5s20130601T000000!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 在愛沙尼亞經常可以找到**橢圓形**的藍色門牌號碼。
注意：這在其他波羅的海國家並不常見，但也能在[俄羅斯](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.0913517,28.1667574,3a,15y,304.49h,91.94t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTX_XXjOnF4tmR0_rySvAQQ!2e0!5s20130601T000000!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)找到。

text: Blue house numbers with the number written with [Arabic numerals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arabic_numerals) in the top left and with [Eastern Arabic numerals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_Arabic_numerals) in the bottom right, with a thin **diagonal line** between them, can be found in Bethlehem. [Street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/eouNa6SnvDgD8WQr9) will generally have the same format.
text_zh: 藍色門牌號碼，左上角用[阿拉伯數字](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arabic_numerals)書寫，右下角用[東阿拉伯數字](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_Arabic_numerals)書寫，兩者之間有一條細**斜線**，可以在伯利恆找到。[街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/eouNa6SnvDgD8WQr9)通常也會採用相同的格式。

text: House numbers in Rosh Haayin are blue, with a **G-clef** in the bottom left corner.
text_zh: 羅什阿因（Rosh Haayin）的門牌號碼是藍色的，左下角有一個**高音譜記號**（G-clef）。

text: In Ness Ziona, There is an **Israeli flag** on house numbers.
text_zh: 在尼斯錫安納（Ness Ziona），門牌號碼上有一個**以色列國旗**。

text: Blue, **shield-shaped house numbers** are unique to the city of Herzliya.
text_zh: 藍色、**盾形門牌號碼**是海爾茲利亞（Herzliya）市特有的。

text: Latvian house numbers are often shaped like **tall rectangles** and can be found in [several colours](https://www.google.com/maps/@56.6568307,23.7457261,3a,15y,38.74h,91.25t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sP7bXCAylAr5ghFSDKp9l1g!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
NOTE: This is not common in Estonia or Lithuania.
text_zh: 拉脫維亞的門牌號碼通常形狀像**高矩形**，並且有[多種顏色](https://www.google.com/maps/@56.6568307,23.7457261,3a,15y,38.74h,91.25t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sP7bXCAylAr5ghFSDKp9l1g!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)。
注意：這在愛沙尼亞或立陶宛並不常見。

text: House numbers in Slovakia are typically written on **white signs **with a thin red or black border.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的門牌號碼通常寫在帶有細紅框或黑框的**白色標誌**上。

text: Slovenian house numbers are typically **red** with white text.
NOTE: [Czech](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.7257121,15.1788819,3a,15y,1.15h,98.69t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4rpA0yUvp4TJif4QGtcHvQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) house numbers are also commonly red.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的門牌號碼通常為**紅色**配白色文字。
註：[捷克](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.7257121,15.1788819,3a,15y,1.15h,98.69t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4rpA0yUvp4TJif4QGtcHvQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)的門牌號碼通常也是紅色。

text: Instead of the normal red house numbers, Ljubljana will typically feature **green house numbers**.
NOTE: [Street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/h5GSwk121qRJantj8) in Ljubljana are also occasionally green.
text_zh: 盧比安納通常會使用**綠色門牌號碼**，而不是一般的紅色門牌號碼。
註：盧比安納的[街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/h5GSwk121qRJantj8)偶爾也是綠色的。

text: Korean buildings have very distinctive **house numbers**. They are blue and usually are shaped quite literally like a house. The full address of the building is written on them, in both Hangul and Latin script.
Some places have unique house numbers, which you can use to region-guess. More information about this can be found in the spotlight section.
text_zh: 南韓建築物有非常獨特的**門牌號碼**。它們是藍色的，通常字面上就做成房子的形狀。建築物的完整地址寫在上面，包含諺文和拉丁字母。
有些地方有獨特的門牌號碼，你可以用來進行地區猜測。關於這點的更多資訊可以在焦點（spotlight）部分找到。

text: House numbers in the Hampyeong region can be recognised from the **large white section** at the top of the sign.
text_zh: 咸平地區的門牌號碼可以透過標誌頂部的**大片白色區域**來辨識。

text: Red street signs with a coloured bottom strip are found in several cities. In the bottom right corner, you can find a white arrow and some numbers. If this arrow is pointing in **both directions** and has a **single arrowhead**, rather than [double](https://goo.gl/maps/Fd5tuzksA3NY8YsF7), then you are almost certainly in Istanbul.

Beware that simple arrows pointing in only one direction can be found in both [Istanbul](https://goo.gl/maps/6uFmLFqcEn2bT7vL9) and in [other cities](https://goo.gl/maps/BBU6aeQ2BoBN38YH8). However, if you see such signs in combination with [red house numbers](https://goo.gl/maps/kjNkwByQZ7rNaQXdA), then you should be in Istanbul.
text_zh: 帶有彩色底條的紅色街道標誌可在多個城市找到。在右下角，你會看到一個白色箭頭和一些數字。如果這個箭頭指向 **雙向** 且只有 **單側箭頭**，而非[雙側箭頭](https://goo.gl/maps/Fd5tuzksA3NY8YsF7)，那麼你幾乎可以確定身處伊斯坦堡。
請注意，只指向單一方向的簡單箭頭既可在[伊斯坦堡](https://goo.gl/maps/6uFmLFqcEn2bT7vL9)找到，也可在[其他城市](https://goo.gl/maps/BBU6aeQ2BoBN38YH8)找到。然而，如果你看到此類標誌搭配[紅色門牌號碼](https://goo.gl/maps/kjNkwByQZ7rNaQXdA)，那你應該就在伊斯坦堡。

text: Street signs in Trabzon and [Yalvaç](https://goo.gl/maps/vZmpbacvJeyzbMWc9) are **red** and **oval-shaped**. [House numbers](https://goo.gl/maps/96X34Wg24K87jPG4A) also feature the same design.
text_zh: 特拉布宗與[亞爾瓦奇](https://goo.gl/maps/vZmpbacvJeyzbMWc9)的街道標誌為 **紅色** 且呈 **橢圓形**。[門牌號碼](https://goo.gl/maps/96X34Wg24K87jPG4A)也採用相同的設計。

text: A horizontal blue, red, or green sign can commonly be seen at the ends of driveways in Wisconsin and the Michigan peninsula. The house number is present, in addition to either the **town name** and or the **road name** (usually).
NOTE: Nearby states often use [similar markers](https://goo.gl/maps/ETNAA9cvLDbB92Lw9), but typically lack any town or street name information and only feature numbers.
text_zh: 在威斯康辛州和密西根半島的車道盡頭，常可見到水平的藍色、紅色或綠色標誌。除了門牌號碼外，通常還會附上**城鎮名稱**和/或**道路名稱**。
注意：鄰近的州經常使用[類似的標示](https://goo.gl/maps/ETNAA9cvLDbB92Lw9)，但通常缺乏任何城鎮或街道名稱資訊，且僅有數字。

intro.lead: 門牌的底色與字體是安靜但可靠的線索
body: 看門牌的形狀、底色與字體。藍底白字、紅底白字、琺瑯質感的橢圓牌都各有所屬地區，在住宅區到處都是卻常被忽略。
門牌通常也會一併寫上街道名稱，可以順便取得語言線索。
